entities.summary: Éric Toussaint is a historian and political scientist with a PhD from the universities of Paris VIII and Liège. He is spokesperson for the CADTM international network, and sits on the Scientific Council of ATTAC France. He is the author of World Bank : A Critical History, Pluto, London, 2023 Greece 2015 There was an alternative, Resistance Books, the IIRE and the CADTM, London, 2020 and The World Bank : A Critical History, Pluto, London, 2023. The previous ones were: The Debt System. A History of Sovereign Debts and their Repudiation, Haymarket books, Chicago, 2019 Bankocracy (2015); and The Life and Crimes of an Exemplary Man (2014).

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a prominent historian and spokesperson for the CADTM international network, Éric Toussaint has contributed to the global debate on debt and economic inequality, influencing policies in Greece and beyond. His work has also shed light on the history of the World Bank, providing critical context for understanding its impact on global development.
